safety_verdicts.content: Patient has tried E45 cream and antihistamines with minimal relief.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated captures E45 cream being ineffective but does not mention antihistamines trialed (Gold includes both E45 and antihistamines).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that antihistamines were tried may lead to redundant recommendations or a less complete picture of prior self-management, but it is unlikely to directly change urgent management of suspected contact dermatitis. Clinical impact is generally limited to minor inefficiency and documentation incompleteness.
